subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Shyam is a student of grade 9 living in a small district town named Magura. He studies at Chander Hut Bidyaloya. His father was a sportsman in his student life and now (a) ------- him to stay active through games or exercise. That’s why Shyam and his father go for a morning walk almost every day for about an hour. At school, he enjoys playing kabadi, gollachut, and other indoor games. He also tries his skills in long and high jump. But it is football that he feels (b) ------- about, and he plays it at the nearby college field. Shyam also watches TV during his leisure time. Apart from sports programmes, he loves watching (c) ------- on channels like National Geographic and Discovery. These shows are not only entertaining but also educational. Recently, he got a (d) ------- camera from his father as a reward for his excellent result in the Junior Secondary exam. Now he dreams of becoming a photographer—not just for parties or people, but to capture the (e) ------- of Bangladesh. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) inspires; (b) passionate; (c) documentaries; (d) flashy; (e) beauty;
